descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S02 「第 3 步：生产环境的 Convex 备份设置和文档里的配置一致」 Step 3: the production Convex backup setting matches the documented configuration

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U13 Backups are encrypted, taken daily only, kept 7 days for disaster recovery and documented; the Convex backup setting matches the documented configuration.（UAT OAT-04；UAT OAT-04 step 3；UAT OAT-04 Expected 3；TFA-94699 AC 8；TFA-94703 AC 1 (B4)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-94703 development backlog

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given The production deployment (Venkata Technologies' Convex Pro account) and the written backup configuration (where it lives is Q12)

When A person with dashboard access opens the deployment's backup settings and compares them with the document

Then Backups are on, daily only, kept 7 days and encrypted, and every value matches the document

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-04 step 3 / Expected 3, TFA-94699 AC 8, TFA-94703 B4: any value other than daily / 7 days / encrypted, a mismatch with the document, or no document = Fail. Whether the document must also say who can restore and how is Q12 ('needs a decision', not a Fail). Evidence: dated screenshot of the setting and the document link, attached to the UAT result

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 CONFIG · 配置核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S02 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
